short: Fabrication and mechanical properties of self-toughening ZrB
title: Fabrication and mechanical properties of self-toughening ZrB2-SiC composites from in-situ reaction

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: ZrB2-SiC ultra-high-temperature ceramics are hard to densify and brittle; toughness is wanted without adding separate reinforcements. Reacting ZrSi2, B4C and carbon in situ under pressure, with extra ZrSi2 as a transient liquid, should grow interlocking ZrB2 platelets that toughen the composite itself.
states.detail: Absorbed: q1 (HYP/need), q2 (HYP/hypothesis), q3 (DES/base_system), q4 (DES/variable_sweep), q5 (DES/route), q6 (PRC/synthesis)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: The product is ZrB2 and SiC with trace ZrO2 and WSi2, residual ZrSi2 from the excess, and ZrC above 20 vol% ZrSi2. ZrB2 grows anisotropically into platelets that meet edge to edge and form an interlocking network.
states.detail: Absorbed: q7 (STR/phase/identity), q8 (STR/microstructure/shape), q9 (STR/microstructure/feature_size), q10 (STR/microstructure/porosity). Premises: Gibbs free energies of the three candidate reactions: reaction (1) is far more negative at all temperatures, so little B4C is left to react with ZrC; In the ZrB2-ZrSi2-SiC system a high ZrSi2 content raises porosity through interaction with the ceramic components

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The exothermic reaction locally melts ZrSi2 and the surface oxides; the liquid plus applied pressure lets ZrB2 grow along its fast directions and lets the platelets slide into interlock. Vickers hardness and flexural strength rise then fall with ZrSi2 content, peaking at 17.1 GPa and 655 MPa for 20 vol%.
states.detail: Absorbed: q11 (MEC/pathway), q12 (PRP/value), q13 (PRP/value), q14 (PRP/behavior_class), q15 (MEC/pathway). Premises: ZrB2 is hexagonal, grows fastest on the {010} and {110} families along <210> and <110>, which favours platelet growth as in Si3N4; Fine SiC raises the mechanical properties of ZrB2-SiC while coarse SiC grains act as critical flaws; The thermal-expansion mismatch between ZrB2 and SiC leaves tangential tensile residual stress around SiC grains on cooling

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: In-situ reactive hot pressing with 20 vol% excess ZrSi2 gives a self-toughened ZrB2-SiC of 17.1 GPa, 655 MPa and 6.08 MPa m^1/2

nodes.title: MICRO, F5
nodes.head: Grey ZrB2, black SiC and bright WSi2 are intermixed on the polished surfaces, with arrows marking elongated ZrB2 grains. Inside the marked box of the high-magnification panel the grains meet edge to edge in a connected network
nodes.solves: ZrB2 grows anisotropically into platelets that meet edge to edge and form an interlocking network
nodes.note: both panels carry 2 um bars (OCR cue); only the arrowed grains are clearly elongated, while most grey grains are angular and roughly equiaxed at this magnification 1 um bar (OCR cue); the interlocking label points at a dash-dot box, and the grain-size distribution inside it is visibly bimodal. Judge check of F5c: the edge-to-edge contact is visible, but most grains inside the box are angular and near-equiaxed at this magnification and only a minority are clearly elongated, so the platelet reading is the weaker part of this panel

nodes.title: MICRO, F8
nodes.head: Fracture surfaces go from open pores with submicron SiC at 0 vol%, through tiny pores with nano SiC and mixed inter- and transgranular platelet fracture, to an interlocked region at 20 vol% and coarse grains with a secondary crack at 25 vol%
nodes.solves: Fracture is a mixed mode: larger platelets break transgranularly, smaller ones along their boundaries
nodes.note: all five panels carry 1 um bars (OCR cue) and the features named in the text are arrow-labelled on the panels themselves
nodes.necessity_reason: S2 keeps shown support from r8, r9, r11 after removal.

nodes.title: MICRO, F8
nodes.head: The indentation crack steps, forks and leaves bridging ligaments and pulled-out grains, with the fork sitting at a bright SiC-rich region
nodes.solves: Interlocked platelets arrest and deflect the crack, then pull out and bridge it, while thermal-expansion mismatch at SiC-rich regions branches it, lengthening the crack path
